from collections import deque
grid = [
"B B B B W g W g W B B B B",
"B B B B g B g B g B B B B",
"B B B B R g R g W g W g W",
"B B B B B B g B B B B B g",
"W g W g W g W g W g W g W",
"g B g B B B g B g B g B B",
"R g W B B B W g W g W B B",
"B B g B B B B B B B g B B",
"B B W g N B B B B B b B B"]
G = [row.split() for row in grid]
R, C = 9, 13
reds = {(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if G[r][c]=='R'}
def dest(r,c,dr,dc, trail):
    r2,c2 = r+dr, c+dc
    while 0<=r2<R and 0<=c2<C:
        t = G[r2][c2]
        if t=='B': return None
        if t=='g': r2,c2 = r2+dr, c2+dc; continue
        return (r2,c2)
    return (r2-dr, c2-dc)
def safe(r,c,dr,dc):
    if dr!=0: return True
    for (rr,cc) in reds:
        if rr==r and abs(cc-c)<=2: return False
    return True
start=(8,10); goal=(8,4)
q = deque([(start, frozenset())])
seen = {(start, frozenset())}
parent = {}
found=None
while q:
    pos, trail = q.popleft()
    if pos==goal: found=(pos,trail); break
    r,c = pos
    for name,dr,dc in (('UP',-1,0),('DOWN',1,0),('LEFT',0,-1),('RIGHT',0,1)):
        if not safe(r,c,dr,dc): continue
        d = dest(r,c,dr,dc,trail)
        if d is None: continue
        st = (d, trail | {pos})
        if st not in seen:
            seen.add(st); parent[st]=(pos,trail,name); q.append(st)
print('found:', found is not None)
pos,trail = found
seq=[]; st=(pos,trail)
while st in parent:
    p,tr,name = parent[st]
    seq.append(name); st=(p,tr)
print(' '.join(reversed(seq)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
